customManagers.description: Track the trufflehog scanner image. The github-actions manager only reads 'uses:' lines, but that action is a wrapper that runs 'ghcr.io/trufflesecurity/trufflehog:${version}'; without this the pinned scanner would silently go stale.

packageRules.description: trufflehog releases the action wrapper and the scanner image from one repository, and tests/unit/test_trufflehog_workflow_yaml.py requires the workflow to name the same release for both. Group them so a bump lands as one pull request rather than two that each fail that check.
Pin python to 3.13 until aider-chat and other adapters confirm 3.14 compatibility.
Hold major updates back longer so a fast-follow patch can land before we bump.

Hold TypeScript on 6.x for the npm packages: ts-jest's peer range is '>=4.3 <7', so a TypeScript 7 bump makes 'npm ci' fail with ERESOLVE. Renovate updates package.json and the lockfile together, so a bump within this range stays consistent. Lift this once ts-jest supports TypeScript 7.
